Risk: AI hiring rules change or a regulator challenges a screening or interview AI use
Mitigation: Advisory-only design; AI register; bias tests; regional switches; legal watch

Risk: Candidate data processed in a region not allowed for a country
Mitigation: Region map per partner; regional controls; transfer assessments; monitoring

Risk: Partner outage or API change breaks assessment, check or job posting flows
Mitigation: Contract tests; monitoring; fallback manual path; version watch

Risk: Vendor lock-in as many flows depend on one partner
Mitigation: Capability interface; canonical model; exit plan; annual exit test

Risk: Sensitive check or medical data stored in the hiring system
Mitigation: Outcome-only design; DQ-11; DLP rules; audits

Risk: Hire hand-off creates wrong or duplicate employee records
Mitigation: Mapping tests; idempotency; reconciliation; work items for failures

Risk: Regional TA teams resist a common process
Mitigation: Working group; local variants as decisions; champions; wave rollout

Risk: Candidate drop-off from long or confusing application
Mitigation: Mobile-first test; chat option; short forms; funnel monitoring

Risk: Works council or union objection to AI interviewing or monitoring
Mitigation: Early engagement; transparency pack; opt-out; local agreement
Vault; rotation; scoped access; anomaly alerts

Risk: Legacy data quality blocks migration and creates duplicates
Mitigation: DQ baseline; de-duplication; retention filter before load

Risk: Too many extensions delay delivery and upgrades
Mitigation: Fit-to-standard discipline; ADR for each gap

Risk: Marketplace partner missing in a country or language
Mitigation: Regional adapter pattern; selection scorecard; local partner list

Risk: Bias in assessments or screening goes unnoticed
Mitigation: Adverse-impact monitoring; validation evidence; periodic audit

Risk: Recruiter and manager adoption stays low
Mitigation: Role-based enablement; mobile and chat; adoption KPIs; hypercare

Risk: Time pressure compresses testing before go-live
Mitigation: Quality gates; test-script pack; integration tests in sandbox

Risk: Product roadmap shift as the vendor integrates with its new parent
Mitigation: Track roadmap; keep to open APIs; contract commitments
Early ordering after acceptance; provider SLAs; status alerts
